angle.hook: the cat-cow herding adventure Herdling now has a dedicated Switch 2 Edition on the eShop, reported by Nintendo Everything
angle.why_now: Nintendo Everything reported the edition went live on the eShop on 11 Nov, regional rollout still under way over the next day, and the Arabic press has not carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Switch 1 and Switch 2 players in the Gulf may find it in the eShop as it rolls out, the price is not stated by the outlet, and the Steam version supports Arabic
angle.payoff: better resolution and performance are promised, price unconfirmed, Arabic support is confirmed only on Steam
